mapper.select: SELECT c.*, p.name AS parent_name FROM sound_category c LEFT JOIN sound_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE c.is_active = true ORDER BY COALESCE(p.sort_order, c.sort_order), c.parent_id NULLS FIRST, c.sort_order
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sound_category WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = true)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sound_category c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.is_active = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sound_category ch WHERE ch.parent_id = c.id))
SELECT * FROM sound_tag WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sound_tag WHERE is_active = true AND id IN #{id}
SELECT bt.block_id, t.id, t.name FROM block_tag bt JOIN sound_tag t ON t.id = bt.tag_id AND t.is_active = true WHERE bt.block_id IN #{id} ORDER BY bt.block_id, t.sort_order
